# Hamza Ali Basra

> Hamza Ali Basra (born 1 November 1998) is a Pakistani entrepreneur. Founder of Grab AI Tool (an AI tools directory) and ToolPixi (free browser-based online tools). He also publishes Daily Insights: short essays on entrepreneurship and building an audience honestly.

## Who he is

- Name: Hamza Ali Basra
- Born: 1 November 1998
- Role: Entrepreneur, founder of Grab AI Tool and ToolPixi
- Media contact: hamzaalibasra786@gmail.com
